title: HUST Information Retrieval Corpus
subtitle: HUST pages, documents, pictures and link graph in the class's Mongo format
description: Versioned corpus of the crawler project (WebCorpusPipeline): the html, picture, other and graph collections as JSON lines, and the crawler's data folders (state, raw HTML, document files) as data-*.tar.gz.bin, which are gzip tar files. Load with `crawler corpus pull`.
